title: A microstrip's copper thickness: Z0 of a 0.35 mm trace over 0.2 mm of εr 4.3, 17.5, 35 and 70 µm thick
source: E. Hammerstad and Ø. Jensen, Accurate models for microstrip computer-aided design, IEEE MTT-S International Microwave Symposium Digest 1980, pp. 407–409: the strip of thickness t by its effective widths (Δu₁ = (t/πh) ln(1 + 4e/((t/h) coth²√(6.517 u))), Δu_r = ½(1 + 1/cosh√(εr − 1)) Δu₁, Z = Z_air(u_r)/√ε_eff(u_r)), a fit within about 1 %. Reference values evaluated independently of EMCraft from the published formulas.
